# Author: Marc Lane

# ENCE - Implementations with betas

Run this .Rmd to reproduce the results from the first part of Section 4.2 of my thesis

## Setup

Load the Met Eireann daily data (not available in this Github repo), apply the station completeness cutoff percentage

```{r setup, message=FALSE}

cutoff <- 0.50 # Set completeness cutoff percentage

source("scripts_with_betas/idw.R")
source("scripts_with_betas/ENCE_C_naive.R")
source("scripts_with_betas/naive_elastic_net_C_implementation/elastic_net_R_glue.R")
source("scripts_with_betas/ENCE_C_warmstart.R")
source("scripts_with_betas/warmstart_elastic_net_C_implementation/elastic_net_R_glue.R")
source("scripts_with_betas/ENCE_C_active.R")
source("scripts_with_betas/active_elastic_net_C_implementation/elastic_net_R_glue.R")

data_root <- Sys.getenv("MET_EIREANN_DATA", unset = "../../../met_eireann_daily_data")

lambda_options <- c(0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05, 0.025, 0.01)
alpha_options  <- c(0.1, 0.35, 0.65, 0.9)

# Load Met Eireann daily data and station geodata file
years <- 2016:2025
files    <- sprintf("%s/daily_rainfall_%d.csv", data_root, years)
rain  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, read.csv))

stations <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/station_geodata.csv", data_root))

# Attach coordinates to each daily observation
missing_geo <- setdiff(unique(rain$stno), stations$stno)
if (length(missing_geo)) warning("No geodata for stno: ", paste(missing_geo, collapse=", "))
rain <- merge(rain, stations[, c("stno", "east", "north")], by = "stno")

# Reshape to the format the rest of the code expects: stno, east, north, t, y
rain <- rain[, c("stno", "east", "north", "t", "rain")]
names(rain)[5] <- "y"

# Sorts the table in place by stno, then t
rain <- rain[order(rain$stno, rain$t), ]

# Compute missingness per station
# Counts the number of observed days per station
obs_per_station <- aggregate(!is.na(rain$y), list(stno = rain$stno), sum)
# Renames columns
names(obs_per_station) <- c("stno", "n_obs")
# Compute total number of days
total_days <- length(unique(rain$t))
# Adds a completeness column = observed days / total days.
obs_per_station$completeness <- obs_per_station$n_obs / total_days

# Apply the % cutoff
keep   <- obs_per_station$stno[obs_per_station$completeness >= cutoff]
rain   <- rain[rain$stno %in% keep, ]

# Setup output file names
tag          <- sprintf("Implementations_Sweep_with_betas")
results_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_implementations_sweep_betas_%s.rds", tag)
log_file     <- sprintf("section_4_2_implementations_sweep_betas_%s.txt", tag)


# Then mask a fraction of the currently-observed cells
set.seed(541)
observed_idx <- which(!is.na(rain$y))
masked_idx   <- sort(sample(observed_idx, length(observed_idx) * 0.25))

df_miss <- rain
df_miss$y[masked_idx] <- NA           # hide masked
```

## Imputation
```{r run-naive, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Run naive C implementation
naive_time <- system.time({
  naive_imp <- ENCE_C_naive(df_miss, response = "y", max_cycles = 30,
                init_method = "idw",
                x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                C = 15000,
                transformation = sqrt,
                reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2,
                truth = rain$y, masked_idx = masked_idx,
                lambda_options = lambda_options,
                alpha_options  = alpha_options,
                nthreads = 16)
})["elapsed"]
```

```{r run-warmstart, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Run warmstart C implementation
warmstart_time <- system.time({
  warmstart_imp <- ENCE_C_warmstart(df_miss, response = "y", max_cycles = 30,
                init_method = "idw",
                x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                C = 15000,
                transformation = sqrt,
                reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2,
                truth = rain$y, masked_idx = masked_idx,
                lambda_options = lambda_options,
                alpha_options  = alpha_options,
                nthreads = 16)
})["elapsed"]
```

```{r run-active, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
active_time <- system.time({
  active_imp <- ENCE_C_active(df_miss, response = "y", max_cycles = 30,
                init_method = "idw",
                x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                C = 15000,
                transformation = sqrt,
                reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2,
                truth = rain$y, masked_idx = masked_idx,
                lambda_options = lambda_options,
                alpha_options  = alpha_options,
                nthreads = 16)
})["elapsed"]
```

## Results

​```{r results, message=FALSE}
naive_y     <- naive_imp$y[masked_idx]
warmstart_y <- warmstart_imp$y[masked_idx]
active_y    <- active_imp$y[masked_idx]
true_y      <- rain$y[masked_idx]

report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n\n")
}

log_lines <- capture.output({
  report_metrics(true_y, naive_y, "Naive", naive_time)
  report_metrics(true_y, warmstart_y, "Warmstart", warmstart_time)
  report_metrics(true_y, active_y, "Active", active_time)
})
writeLines(log_lines, log_file)
cat(log_lines, sep = "\n")
​```

## Save Results

​```{r save_results}
results <- list(
  meta = list(
    description = "C implementation beta diagnostic (single 25% mask split): naive vs warmstart vs active-set",
    cutoff      = cutoff,
    mask_frac   = 0.25,
    mask_seed   = 541,
    years       = years,
    n_stations  = length(keep),
    n_observed  = length(observed_idx),
    n_masked    = length(masked_idx),
    run_time    = Sys.time(),
    hostname       = Sys.info()[["nodename"]],
    slurm_job_id   = Sys.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID"),
    slurm_nodelist = Sys.getenv("SLURM_NODELIST"),
    r_version      = R.version.string

  ),

  naive_time = naive_time,
  warmstart_time = warmstart_time,
  active_time = active_time,

  true_y = true_y,
  naive_y = naive_y,
  warmstart_y = warmstart_y,
  active_y = active_y,

  naive_rmse_history     = attr(naive_imp, "rmse_history"),
  warmstart_rmse_history = attr(warmstart_imp, "rmse_history"),
  active_rmse_history    = attr(active_imp, "rmse_history"),
  naive_val_history      = attr(naive_imp, "val_rmse_history"),
  warmstart_val_history  = attr(warmstart_imp, "val_rmse_history"),
  active_val_history     = attr(active_imp, "val_rmse_history"),

  naive_ls_history     = attr(naive_imp, "ls_history"),
  naive_as_history      = attr(naive_imp, "as_history"),
  warmstart_ls_history  = attr(warmstart_imp, "ls_history"),
  warmstart_as_history  = attr(warmstart_imp, "as_history"),
  active_ls_history     = attr(active_imp, "ls_history"),
  active_as_history     = attr(active_imp, "as_history"),

  stno = rain$stno[masked_idx],
  t    = rain$t[masked_idx]
)

saveRDS(results, results_file)

write.csv(attr(naive_imp, "beta_history"),     sprintf("betas_naive_history_cutoff%d.csv", cutoff*100),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(attr(warmstart_imp, "beta_history"), sprintf("betas_warmstart_history_cutoff%d.csv", cutoff*100), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(attr(active_imp, "beta_history"),    sprintf("betas_active_history_cutoff%d.csv", cutoff*100),    row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved results to", results_file, "\n")
​```
